relationships.coverage_scope_note: Coverage applies only to parsed JSON-object rows in these two scanned inputs. Preview or independently sampled files cannot establish full-dataset coverage. Numerators count original review rows, before any join multiplication; unusable parent IDs are not matched or normalized.
relationships.interpretation: All results refer to scanned objects only; preview mode does not establish full-file key uniqueness or completeness. Multiple metadata rows for one parent may multiply joined review rows, but do not prove full-record duplicates. Join row counts are projected without materializing a join.

temporal_ordering.note: Ties are based on identical raw timestamps and exact nonblank parent IDs. Only successfully parsed review objects with a convertible timestamp and usable parent are eligible for tie counting. These counts do not establish which reviews qualify for the modeling task; no sorting or tie-breaking of individual reviews is performed.

modality_inventory.meaning_and_limitations: Review headline/body; one or both can be missing, null or blank.
modality_inventory.availability_note: A source field being observed even once is NOT proof of availability for every sample. Metadata joins alone do not guarantee the specific product field is usable. S22 will count modality availability.
